note.en: Use a two-dimensional field restricted to periodic transverse wave number ky = 4 and c = 1. The slab [4, 5] has epsilon_inf = 1.5, delta_epsilon = 0.75, omega_0 = 9, gamma = 0.5 and sigma = 0.04. Outer vacuum ends at PEC caps [-24, 36]; T = 60. Analytic reference Vacuum surroundings, ky = 4, slab [4, 5], epsilon_inf = 1.5, delta_epsilon = 0.75, omega_0 = 9, gamma = 0.5 and sigma = 0.04. Compare omega = 5.1/6/6.9 for both s = Ez and p = Hz. This is a genuine single-ky restriction rather than arbitrary transverse data. It covers one passive Lorentz pole and a fixed finite band/window. Gaussian tails are nonzero; window diagnostics and reference errors are reported separately. No strict all-frequency no-return proof is claimed.

name.en: Isolated same-grid reference for a long grazing dispersive packet

note.ja: c=1、均質Lorentz媒質ε∞=1、Δε=0.2、ω0=12はPML内まで連続。512/768/1024点とpeak6/9/12を同時に細分化します。垂直粗格子はpeak6、弱減衰細格子対照はpeak12。長さ64、層幅12、中心32、幅4、carrier6は固定です。 有限格子の数値参照 均質Lorentz媒質はPML内まで連続し、ε∞=1、Δε=0.2、ω0=12、γ=0または0.005。Ez偏光の有限kx Gaussianはcarrierω=6、中心位相角80度。512/768/1024点とpeak6/9/12を同時細分化し、垂直対照は6、弱減衰細格子対照は12。最終時刻は700です。 有限kx帯域の中心角が80度で、全成分が厳密に80度ではありません。無PML参照は同じ離散化・初期場を使い、伝播分散を除いた境界誤差用です。任意角度・材料での大域安定性証明ではありません。 固定PMLの空間次数を測る族ではなく、旧100検査だけでpeak12の大域安定性が証明されたとはしません。
note.en: Use c = 1 and a homogeneous Lorentz medium with epsilon_inf = 1, delta_epsilon = 0.2 and omega_0 = 12 continuing through the PML. Joint refinement uses 512/768/1024 cells and peaks 6/9/12. The normal coarse control has peak 6; the damped fine companion has peak 12. Length 64, layer thickness 12, center 32, width 4 and carrier 6 are fixed. Finite-grid numerical reference The homogeneous Lorentz medium continues through the PML: epsilon_inf = 1, delta_epsilon = 0.2, omega_0 = 12, gamma = 0 or 0.005. An Ez-polarized finite-kx Gaussian has carrier omega = 6 and central phase angle 80 degrees. Joint grid/layer refinement uses peaks 6/9/12 on 512/768/1024 cells; the normal control uses 6 and damped fine companion 12. Final time is 700. The central angle is 80 degrees; finite kx bandwidth gives neighboring angles. The no-PML reference shares the discretization and initialization to isolate boundary error from bulk dispersion. Small operator and finite-trajectory checks do not prove global stability for arbitrary angles and materials. The joint family does not measure fixed-PML spatial order; the older 100 checks alone do not prove peak-12 global stability.
